translations.web: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: You can verify for yourself that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
translations.kjv: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
